brand.name: HomeLink Africa
brand.tagline: Verified stays, cars, and days out across Rwanda.

landing.heroTitle: A home that is ready when you land
landing.heroBody: Every stay, car, and guide on HomeLink has been inspected in person by our team in Kigali. If it is here, we have stood in the room.
landing.feedBody: Newly inspected and ready to book.

gallery.label: Photos
gallery.placeholderNote: Photography is commissioned per listing and is not in the shell yet. These panels stand in for the real set.

verification.title: Verified by someone who stood in the room

steps.inspectedBody: Checked against a 34-point list covering water pressure, power backup, road access, and the kitchen.
steps.photographedBody: Every image here was shot by the HomeLink team. No owner-supplied photos appear on a verified listing.
steps.identityBody: Title or lease authority verified against national ID. Identity checks complete before any payout is possible.
steps.escrowBody: Payment sits in escrow until you confirm check-in. Not as described means a full refund and another home the same night.

car.inspectedBody: Serviced, road-tested, and checked against a 22-point list covering tyres, brakes, spare, jack, and papers.
car.identityBody: Operator ownership and insurance verified against the vehicle registration before it can be hired.
car.photographedBody: Photographed by the HomeLink team, this exact vehicle — not a manufacturer stock shot of the model.
car.title: Verified by someone who drove it

experience.inspectedBody: Run in full by a member of our team before it was listed, on an 18-point check covering safety, timing, and what is actually included.
experience.identityBody: Guide licensing and park accreditation verified, and renewed each season.
experience.photographedBody: Photographed on a real departure by the HomeLink team.
experience.title: Verified by someone who went on it

trust.noSurprises: The price you see is the price you pay

status.lowAvailability: {count, plural, one {# left for these dates} other {# left for these dates}}

segment.label: Viewing as
segment.hint: Sets your language, currency, and payment method. Change anything at any time.

dev.label: Preview as
dev.note: Development only. Roles are mocked until accounts are wired up.

empty.noResultsBody: We only list what we have inspected, so results are narrower than you may expect. Try widening the dates or clearing a filter.
empty.comingSoonBody: This screen is part of the shell but has no content behind it yet.

detail.unavailable: Choose dates to see the total
detail.leaseBody: Twelve months or more is handled as a lease application rather than a nightly booking: documents, a deposit, and a signed agreement.
detail.houseRulesBody: Check in from 14:00, check out by 11:00. No parties. Quiet after 22:00, which the neighbours will thank you for.

quote.chargedIn: Charged in {currency}. Converted at today's rate; the amount you are charged is confirmed before you pay.
quote.noHiddenFees: No booking fee is added at the end. This is the price.

checkout.title: Confirm and pay
checkout.mobileNumberError: Rwandan mobile numbers have 9 digits. Check the number and try again.
checkout.stubNotice: Nothing is charged. Payment rails arrive in Phase 2 — this button records the booking against fixture data.
checkout.escrowTitle: Your money is held until you arrive
checkout.escrowBody: We hold the full amount and release it to the host only after you confirm check-in. If the place is not as described, you are refunded in full and we find you another home the same night.
checkout.noEscrowBody: This stay is below our escrow threshold, so payment settles directly. The same guarantee on accuracy still applies.
checkout.cancellation: Free cancellation until {date}. After that the first night is non-refundable.
checkout.agree: By paying you accept the booking terms and the cancellation policy above.

car.noEscrowBody: A hire settles directly to the operator — escrow is for stays above our threshold. The same guarantee on accuracy still applies: if the car is not what this page says, you are not paying for it.

experience.noEscrowBody: A day out settles directly to the guide — escrow is for stays above our threshold. The same guarantee on accuracy still applies: if the day is not what this page says, you are not paying for it.

confirmation.title: You're booked
confirmation.body: We've sent the details to your email and opened a thread with the concierge team.
confirmation.referenceHint: Quote this if you call or message us.
confirmation.next1: Aline from our Kigali team will message you within a few hours to confirm arrival details.
confirmation.next2: Your money stays in escrow until you confirm check-in.
confirmation.next3: About a week before you arrive, Aline will ask whether you want a car or anything else arranged.
confirmation.arrangeBody: A car at the airport, a driver for the week, a day out somewhere worth going. Tell the Kigali team and they'll arrange it — no second booking, no separate account.
confirmation.arrangeNote: They'll also check in about a week before you land, once you know your flight.

cars.title: Cars
cars.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# vetted vehicle} other {# vetted vehicles}} in Kigali, serviced and checked before every hire.
cars.driverOnly: This vehicle comes with a driver.
cars.daysTotal: total for {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
cars.bothModesHeading: Drive it yourself, or with a driver
cars.driverOnlyHeading: With a driver, out of Kigali
cars.paperworkSelfBody: Bring your national licence, and an international permit if you are visiting. Insurance, registration and the warning triangle are in the glovebox.
cars.paperworkDriverBody: Nothing to bring. The driver holds the licence, the insurance and the park entry papers.
cars.fuelBody: Handed over full, returned full. No mileage cap, and no surcharge for leaving Kigali.
cars.cancellationBody: Free cancellation until {date}. After that the first day is non-refundable.

experiences.title: Experiences
experiences.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# day out} other {# days out}} with guides we know by name.
experiences.ageNotice: Minimum age for this one is {age}.
experiences.guideRole: Licensed guide. Not a HomeLink employee.
experiences.bringBody: Closed shoes, a rain layer, water. Anything specialised is provided and is already in the price.
experiences.weatherBody: The rain here comes in the afternoon and rarely cancels anything. If a day is called off for safety, it is refunded in full.
experiences.ageBody: Ages {age} and over. The limit is set by the park or the operator, not by us, and it is checked at the meeting point.

searchPanel.placesCount: {count, plural, one {# verified place} other {# verified places}}
searchPanel.leaseNote: A year or more is a lease, not a nightly booking. We'll take you through documents and a deposit instead.

highlight.inspectedBody: {name} checked this place in person on {date}, not from a form.
highlight.escrowBody: We hold it and release it to the host only once you confirm you're in.
highlight.powerBody: Backup generator on site, started and fuelled at inspection.
highlight.fibreBody: Speed tested on the day, not taken from an advert.
highlight.photosBody: Shot by our team. Nothing here came from the owner's phone.

carHighlight.inspectedBody: {name} serviced and road-tested this exact car on {date}, against a {points}-point list.
carHighlight.driverBody: The rate includes someone who has driven these roads for years. On the park routes that is not a luxury.
carHighlight.automaticBody: Kigali is built on ridges and the traffic stops halfway up them. This one changes gear for you.
carHighlight.unpaved: Made for where the tarmac ends
carHighlight.unpavedBody: Ground clearance and four-wheel drive, because half the places worth going stop being roads.
carHighlight.groupBody: {count} seats, so nobody follows in a second car and nobody gets separated.
carHighlight.fleet: There is nearly always one free
carHighlight.fleetBody: {count} on the fleet right now, so moving your dates rarely costs you the booking.

experienceHighlight.inspected: One of us did the whole day
experienceHighlight.inspectedBody: {name} went on this exact outing on {date}, start to finish, before it was listed.
experienceHighlight.permit: The permit is ours to get
experienceHighlight.permitBody: Volcanoes permits sell out months ahead and are priced in dollars. One is held for you, and it is already in the price.
experienceHighlight.halfDayBody: {count} hours door to door, so it fits either side of a working day.
experienceHighlight.smallGroupBody: Capped at {count}. You are not following a raised flag through a crowd.
experienceHighlight.foodBody: Cooked where you are by the people who live there, not carried out from a Kigali kitchen.
experienceHighlight.fullDayBody: {count} hours with transport from Kigali at both ends, not a slot you have to build a day around.

trips.title: Your trips
trips.subtitle: Everything you have booked with us, and the thread that goes with each one.
trips.emptyBody: Nothing booked yet. Everything on HomeLink has been inspected in person, so there is less of it than you might expect — and none of it is a surprise when you arrive.
trips.notYours: This screen belongs to someone else
trips.notYoursBody: Trips is where your own bookings live. If you supply something to HomeLink it is under Inventory, and if you are on the Kigali team it is under Queue.

subtitle.stay: What you have listed with us, what is booked, and when the money reaches you.
subtitle.car: What you have on the fleet, what is hired, and when the money reaches you.
subtitle.experience: What you run with us, what is booked, and when the money reaches you.

inventory.nothingBooked: Nothing booked for these yet. Bookings appear here the moment a guest pays.
inventory.payoutAfterCheckIn: Paid out once the guest confirms check-in
inventory.payoutOnStart: Paid out on the start date
inventory.moneyNote: Nothing on this screen moves money. Payouts are run by the Kigali team, and the amounts here are what they are working from.
inventory.notYours: This screen belongs to someone else
inventory.notYoursBody: Inventory is for hosts, drivers and guides. If you are a guest, your bookings are under Trips.
inventory.ownershipNote: Everything HomeLink has verified in this lane. Which supplier owns what is not modelled yet — in V1 inventory is listed by the concierge team, so there is effectively one supplier.

messaging.title: Messages
messaging.subtitle: Every thread is attached to something you have booked. Nothing here floats free of a booking.
messaging.noThreads: No threads yet. One opens the moment a booking is confirmed.
messaging.replyNote: Sending arrives with the backend. The thread above is fixture data, and this box is here so the layout can be judged with a reply box in it.

queue.title: The queue
queue.subtitle: What is waiting to be verified, what a guest has asked a person for, what is owed to supply, and who is waiting for a reply.
queue.verifyNote: Nothing goes live until someone has stood in it. What nobody has booked in yet is at the top.
queue.asksNote: Every "message the team" button on a confirmation lands here as a job for a person. A long list is the argument for building one of these into the checkout.
queue.payoutsNote: The same escrow a guest reads as safety, read from behind as a job. Held money waits on a confirmed check-in.
queue.readOnlyNote: Nothing on this screen changes anything. Scheduling a visit, publishing a listing and releasing a payout all need a backend, and a dead button next to real money would be worse than no button.
queue.notYours: This screen belongs to the Kigali team
queue.notYoursBody: The queue is the concierge team's tool. If you booked something, it is under Trips; if you supply something, it is under Inventory.
